capabilities: Render AI edits as tracked-change proposals with per-change accept and reject buttons
Chat with connected AI collaborators from a side panel
Attribute accepted changes to authors by color with an audit note
Restore snapshots taken before each external edit
Protect note sections from collaborator edits with %%protect%% markers
disambiguation: It is not an AI assistant itself; it is only the review layer for edits made by externally connected AI tools.
extras: The plugin makes no network requests itself; AI access requires running a bundled Python bridge script or an external agent, and the plugin must be built and installed manually from source. Accepts donations.
problem: Obsidian has no way to see, approve, or attribute edits an AI assistant makes to your notes before they enter your text.

relations.evidence: Connect Claude: get an API key at console.anthropic.com
Users of agent tools that already edit local files, such as Claude Code, need no bridge at all

requires.name: an AI tool that edits vault files (bridge script or agent like Claude Code)

summary: Review layer that turns AI edits of your notes into tracked-change proposals you accept or reject word by word, with chat, attribution and snapshots.
